newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines raises termed reverse repo rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippines raises termed reverse repo rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it had raised interest rates on termed reverse repos after it hiked its overnight borrowing rate earlier in the day.
The five-day reverse repo was increased to 10 percent from the previous 9.9 percent.
The one-month reverse repo was raised to 10.125 percent, while two-month reverse repo was up to 10.1875 percent. Rates for the one-month and two-month reverse repos were previously at 9.9 percent.
The Central Bank also nudged up its six-month reverse repo rate to 10.25 percent from 10.125 percent.
The rate adjustments came after the Central Bank raised its overnight borrowing rate to 10 percent from the previous 9.9 percent.

The interest rate for the 90-day special series treasury bills was increased to 9.5 percent from the previous 9.45 percent, three days after its corresponding auction rate went up slightly after weeks of continuous decline.
The 335-day special series T-bill rate was kept unchanged at 10.3 percent.
